name: Nowhereplatz, U3
source:
It’s Halloween night. A man with a cheap horns headband is waiting for his last train to take him home. The train will eventually arrive, but what is really home for him?

[From [url=https://mlkrn.itch.io/nowhereplatz]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是万圣节之夜。一个戴着廉价牛角头带的男人正在等待最后一班火车带他回家。火车终将抵达，但对他来说，什么才是真正的家呢？

[来自[url=https://mlkrn.itch.io/nowhereplatz]Itch.io[/url]]
